text:
Situation: Oxycodone and acetaminophen tablets and solution are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory provides 13.9 to 31.6 days on hand across three sites. Corvale Lakeside has the lowest coverage at 13.9 days for tablets. Corvale General holds 26.2 days of the 5 mg/5 mL solution.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows oxycodone and acetaminophen is not listed as of 2026-10-21. A product label identifies Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) with operations RELABEL and REPACK and a last inspection classification of VAI on 2026-07-16. FDA inspection records for that plant show an OAI classification from an inspection ending 2009-06-11 and a VAI classification from the most recent inspection ending 2026-07-16.

Our position: Supply is adequate today but uneven across sites. Lakeside's tablet stock is thin. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation protocols. Purchasing from alternate suppliers not on the shortage list is the primary lever.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with Alvogen, Inc. to replenish tablet stock at Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General; P&T Committee approves formulary addition if required.
2. Buyer places orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as secondary tablet source; P&T Committee approves formulary addition if required.
3. Buyer evaluates Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC, Aurolife Pharma LLC, and AvPAK for solution and tablet supply; P&T Committee approves any new formulary entries.
4. Pharmacy Operations redistributes existing tablet inventory from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside to cover immediate needs; Director of Pharmacy approves transfer.

Not recommended: No allocation restrictions or therapeutic substitutions at this time; clinical changes remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
